  {g : α → List.{0} Bool → Option.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} β (List.{0} Bool))} {l : List.{0} Bool} {b : β}
  {rest : List.{0} Bool},
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.bindP f g l) (Option.some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} b rest)) →
    ∃ a rest₁,
      And (Eq.{1} (f l) (Option.some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} a rest₁)))

source.code:
theorem bindP_some {f : List Bool → Option (α × List Bool)}
    {g : α → List Bool → Option (β × List Bool)} {l : List Bool} {b : β} {rest : List Bool}
    (h : bindP f g l = some (b, rest)) :
    ∃ a rest₁, f l = some (a, rest₁) ∧ g a rest₁ = some (b, rest) := by
  unfold bindP at h
  cases hf : f l with
  | none => rw [hf] at h; simp at h
  | some p =>
      obtain ⟨a, rest₁⟩ := p
      rw [hf] at h
      exact ⟨a, rest₁, rfl, h⟩
